name: CustomAssertion
summary: States a domain expectation in one call, so that a test says what should be true rather than how to check it.

roles.name: CustomAssertion
roles.summary: An assertion written for this codebase, named in its own words. It shortens tests and, more importantly, it makes the failure message say something: a comparison of two positions can report which of bay, row and tier moved, where a string comparison reports two strings.
